entries.purpose: Independent deterministic test-only classic ZIP writer and controlled malformed-record mutations.
entries.author: USDZ Validation Kit contributors
entries.obligations: Include the copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
entries.recipe: Compile the committed Swift 6 source with Foundation only. Construct ordered ArchiveRecipe.Entry values and call encode() or encodeWithLayout(). Inputs select raw names, payload, type, flags, method, declared sizes/CRC, extra fields, per-member comments and fixed-header patches; offsets support deterministic byte mutations. Temporary recipes supply large/adversarial cases; no large committed assets. Optional prefix and bytesBeforeDirectory insert verbatim boundary-layout bytes while preserving absolute indexed offsets, for self-extracting, gap and hidden-member recipes. Entry.payloadPatches applies deterministic payload-relative mutations only after CRC and size declarations are recorded, allowing content-corruption fixtures with matching local and central metadata. EntryType includes independently declared Unix character-device, block-device, FIFO and socket modes for namespace/type rejection fixtures; raw-name and central-header patches reproduce unsupported encodings and host/type metadata without product code.
